biography: Born in a small village nestled in the English countryside, John Surtees was practically born behind the wheel. His father, a local mechanic and amateur racer, instilled in him a love for speed and precision from a young age. John began tinkering with engines before he could properly read, and by the age of 16, he was already tearing up local karting circuits. A pivotal moment came during a regional karting championship where, despite starting last due to a mechanical issue, he expertly navigated the treacherous conditions to snatch victory on the final lap. This raw talent and unwavering determination caught the eye of a scout from the prestigious F racing team, who offered him a spot in their junior program. Currently, at the age of 28, Surtees is seen as one of the most promising young talents in the sport, balancing his time between F and commitments with Hoshino Racing Team and Royal Motorsports.
drivingStyle: Surtees is known for his calculating and methodical driving style. He approaches each race with a cool head, meticulously analyzing track conditions and competitor strategies. Rather than relying on outright aggression, he prefers to conserve his tires and pick his moments to attack, often lulling his rivals into a false sense of security before unleashing a decisive overtake. His precision and control through corners are remarkable, allowing him to maintain exceptional speed while minimizing the risk of errors. He is a master of tire management, able to extract every last bit of performance from his rubber, giving him a significant advantage in longer races.

famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about speed; it's about controlling the chaos."
careerHighlight: Winning the F Grand Prix at Silverstone in 2022 after starting from 10th on the grid, showcasing his exceptional overtaking skills and strategic brilliance in front of his home crowd.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2021 due to a mechanical failure, costing his team a victory after 23 hours of flawless performance.
